description: The Medha theme (Bootstrap 5) ported to React: every page, the shared chrome and the theme scripts.

features: Dashboard (`/dashboard`) in the Medha workspace layout: sidebar, topbar, light palette and colour-scheme selector

Every Medha component as its own page under `/dashboard/...`: buttons, grids, typography, icons, cards, navigation, feedback, carousels, inputs, validation, tables, charts, calendar, inbox, compose, FAQ and more
Component explorer (`/dashboard/components`): every page in tabs by section, with search
Rich tools from the theme: WYSIWYG editor, tree diagram and tree editor, UML editor, MathML equation editor and Vedic Sanskrit editor
Reusable typed components for your own screens: `AppShell`, `SiteShell`, `AuthShell`, `PageHeading`, `Panel`, `MetricCard`, `Icon`, `MedhaLogo`

structure.src/App.tsx: All routes; add your own pages here
structure.src/pages: Your pages (the component explorer is an example)
structure.src/medha: The Medha theme ported to React: pages, shared chrome, theme scripts and styles
structure.src/medha/CATALOG.md: Every theme page with its route, component file and scripts
structure.public/medha: Logo, fonts and the equation-editor embed

sections.title: Design system
How the theme pages work
sections.body:
Each HTML page of the Medha theme is a React page component in `src/medha/pages/`. The interactive parts (editors, tree diagrams, the dashboard filters, the colour-scheme designer) are the theme's own scripts in `src/medha/scripts/`. `MedhaPage` runs them after the page renders and removes their listeners, timers and pop-ups when you leave the page, so every page behaves as it did in the static theme.

The sign-in and registration forms are demos: they validate input and go to the dashboard, but nothing is sent anywhere. Connect them to your own API before using them for real accounts.
